guard: L_dbl is a local support model motivated by the source non-Hausdorff leaf-space problem. No homeomorphism between the actual Epstein-Vogt leaf space and the doubled-origin line is claimed.
source_motivation: Sullivan explicitly asks for Thom stratification of the leaf space after allowing non-Hausdorffness; Epstein-Vogt supply spinning/doubling and locally unbounded first-return geometry.

theorems.Hausdorff_target_collapse: every continuous map from L_dbl to a Hausdorff target identifies 0+ and 0-
theorems.controlled_branch_retractions: r_+ and r_- collapse the opposite origin and are continuous retractions onto either one-origin branch
theorems.no_simultaneous_Hausdorff_resolver: a Hausdorff-valued quotient cannot preserve the distinction of the two origins

topology: 0+ and 0- each have neighborhoods consisting of that origin plus a punctured interval; all punctured points are shared
